subject: Coord: ValleyWest workshop — ride credentials, valet windows & liaison plan
messages:
From: Olivia Perez <events@olympia-consulting.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: ValleyWest onsite logistics — rides and guest credentials

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for hosting Acme's product team at ValleyWest next week. Two quick items we need help confirming so our arrival day runs smoothly: 

1) Valet/curb windows: we have 90 guests arriving between 08:30 and 11:15 on Tue 6/1. Can Redwood reserve two valet lanes for 08:15–10:00 and 10:30–12:00? If lanes can't be continuous, please confirm alternate windows.

2) Ride credentials: a handful of executives will request car services (vendor provided) and others will use rideshare. We need a short credential template (paper or digital) so security can allow curb access for drivers. Attached is the event roster — I can pull exact flight times if useful.

Also looping Starline Limo ops to ask about staging capacity behind the loading dock. Can Starline confirm max concurrent vehicles and whether they can provide 4 black SUVs for exec transfers during the morning window?

Appreciate a brief note with the lane allocation and a liaison assignment (name + cell) who'll be on-site for arrival.

Best,
Olivia
Operations, Olympia Consulting
(events@olympia-consulting.com)

Attachments: event-roster.csv (referenced)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Olivia Perez <events@olympia-consulting.com>, Starline Limo <ops@starlinelimo.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ValleyWest onsite logistics — rides and guest credentials

Thanks, Olivia — quick plan proposal below and a couple of asks. I attached a pickup-windows.csv (small matrix) and a guest-credential-template.docx as a starting point.

Proposed lane allocation (Redwood provides staffing + signage):
- Lane A (north curb): 08:15–10:00 — primary drop-off for general attendees and rideshare queuing.
- Lane B (south curb / valet lane): 10:15–12:15 — dedicated to vendor car services and executive loads.

Rationale: splitting the busiest block reduces double-parking in the driveway and gives vendors a guaranteed 45–60 minute exec window. If Starline needs a contiguous block, we can move Lane B to 09:45–11:45 but that overlaps heavy rideshare.

Starline — can you confirm:
- Max concurrent staging spots behind loading dock?
- Ability to guarantee 4 black SUVs from 08:30–11:30 (two-hour rolling window)?
- Do drivers need printed guest credentials or will a QR/digital pass be sufficient for your team?

Operational liaison: I'm proposing Marissa Cole as on-site Redwood liaison for arrival (cell: +1-415-555-0142). Marissa will handle curb assignment and will escalate to Laura if capacity is exceeded. Vivek can champion parking passes and vendor drop-off routing.

Action items (short):
- Starline: confirm staging + SUVs + credential preference.
- Olivia: confirm final attendee count for the morning block and any VIP flight/arrival times.
- Marissa/Vivek: review attached pickup-windows.csv and let me know changes by EOD Mon.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Events (Redwood Inference)
rm@redwood.com

Attachments: pickup-windows.csv, guest-credential-template.docx

From: Starline Limo <ops@starlinelimo.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Olivia Perez <events@olympia-consulting.com>
Cc: jen.holt@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ValleyWest onsite logistics — rides and guest credentials

Hi Rishi / Olivia,

We can support the plan with the following constraints and confirmations: 

- Staging: we have 5 marked staging spots behind the loading dock (max concurrent vehicles = 5). We'll also have 2 overflow spots on the west lot if loading dock is full, which should cover surge periods.
- SUVs: we can provide 4 black SUVs and a lead vehicle for the VIP convoy from 08:15–11:30, with drivers arriving 30 minutes early for credential check-in.
- Credentials: QR/digital passes are fine for our drivers but please provide a printed backup for the curb security team in case signals are poor. We generated a high-level curb map and marked vendor drop-off in the attached valet-map.png.

Small ask: please confirm whether curb security will allow drivers to stage in the valet lane for more than 10 minutes. If staging cannot exceed 10 minutes, we will need the overflow spots to be on-call with a 3–5 minute shuttle to the curb.

Quoted from your earlier note: 
> "Appreciate a brief note with the lane allocation and a liaison assignment (name + cell) who'll be on-site for arrival."

We are good with Marissa as liaison. Please advise whether Aditya (concierge) will hand out printed credentials at door staging.

Thanks,
Marco Diaz
Ops Manager, Starline Limo
ops@starlinelimo.com

Attachments: valet-map.png

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Perez <events@olympia-consulting.com>, Starline Limo <ops@starlinelimo.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ValleyWest onsite logistics — rides and guest credentials

Team — quick confirmation and one change request.

Confirmed: Lane A and Lane B allocation stands. Marissa will be our on-site liaison (thank you). Vivek — please publish 10 printed credential sheets at the security desk and give 25 quick-issue printed passes to Aditya for concierge distribution at the east entrance. Aditya, you'll have a small handheld list to check names + hand over the printed pass.

Change: Starline — please treat the overflow west lot as active staging after 09:30. That should avoid long curb waits. If you anticipate more than 5 concurrent vehicles between 09:15–10:00, call Marissa directly; escalation number is in the sheet Rishi attached.

Let's lock this in and share a one-page arrival run-of-show with Olympia by EOD Sun. Rishi, can you assemble the run sheet (15–20 lines) from the attachments and circulate?

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Events, Redwood Inference
laura_b@redwood.com
